## Recommendation

**Best-supported ligand under the stated KOH conditions: triphenylphosphine (PPh₃)**

- **Exact candidate SMILES:** `c1ccc(cc1)P(c2ccccc2)c3ccccc3`

- **Base:** KOH, represented as `[OH-].[K+]`
- **Reported yield:** **76.3%**
- **Temperature/time:** 100 °C, 5 h
- **Reaction precedent:** exact boronic-acid partner with a closely related bromoquinoline substrate

This is the strongest choice because it is the only retrieved precedent using **KOH specifically**.
